name: Clockout the Ginger Cat
blurb: Clockout, a fluffy ginger tabby with faint forehead stripes and big dark eyes, wears a teal collared shirt and trots home the moment work ends.

name: Brookspot the Spotted Cat
blurb: Brookspot, a tawny house cat with dark leopard-like spots and white streaks by her eyes, keeps watch from the reeds by the sanctuary stream.

name: Bubble the Helmet Cat
blurb: Bubble, a white cat with one red-orange patch over his eye and ear, wears a round clear helmet and checks the garden for specks of dust.
